utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Oren—send me the repair drive list when you’ve got it, and I’ll set the tools aside.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — I’ll grab the list and bring it by as soon as I can. Appreciate you setting the tools aside.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Oren—happy to help out. Just bring it by when you’re ready, and I’ll have everything set aside.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, that’s what I’ve heard too — it’s still on today, but I’m still catching up on the details. If you know anything else, I’d love to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’m still waiting on the repair drive details too, but I’ll send the list over as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’m still piecing it together from the sidelines, so I’ll keep an eye out for your list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m checking what repairs the drive is covering and whether they need any specific items right now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mina — the first step is to sort the repair list and see what tools or supplies each job needs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll sort the repair list and match each job to the tools or supplies it needs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s still on today, and I’m spreading the word right now so folks know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — thanks for confirming. No changes then, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll bring over the bikes first and the rest when I can manage it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works for me, Uli — bring the bikes first and we’ll handle the rest as you can. I’m keeping the repair drive list moving, so just let me know if your timing changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules. I’ll drop the bikes off soon and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send the route and timing in one clear note, with no extra stops. Once you’ve seen it, you can confirm if it works for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — send it over, and I’ll confirm once I’ve seen the route and timing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — I’ll send the route and timing in one clear note so you can confirm it easily.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I’m keeping things by the front entrance, so if you’ve got anything to drop off, bring it over there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I can drop it by the front entrance after the school run. Just let me know if there’s a time you want me to aim for.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works well — anytime after the school run is fine, and I’ll be by the front entrance. Thanks for bringing it over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—I'm near the front entrance, and if you can help sort or carry anything, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—I’m here now and can help sort or carry things near the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—stay near the front entrance, and I’ll point you to the next boxes as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — if you send the route and timing in one clear note, I can confirm once I’ve checked it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send the route and timing in one clear note and keep everyone posted. Thanks, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik—that works for me. Send the note over, and I’ll confirm once I’ve checked the timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — we still need a couple volunteers for the porch railing, one person for the leaky faucet, and anyone who can bring a drill would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the drill covered, and I’ll bring the Phillips and flathead screwdrivers too. I’ll check once more for any other supplies we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you. I’ll note the drill and screwdrivers as covered, and I’ll let you know if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the exact repair list, so I don’t want to guess yet—I’ll confirm what’s needed and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries — just send the confirmed repair list when you have it, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll confirm the list and send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still asking around while I’m out — if I hear of anyone with a drill or able to help, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just send them my way if you hear of anyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m out running errands now, so I’ll keep an ear open and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — first we should sort the repair list and see what tools or supplies we need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll check the repair list and see what tools or supplies we’re missing. I’m a little foggy, but I’ll get back to you with the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren—just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep asking around while I’m out running errands, and if I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for today unless you hear otherwise, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that’s right — as far as I know it’s still on today, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything different while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — send the route, timing, and any supply gaps, and I’ll confirm once I’ve checked it all.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll send over the route, timing, and any supply gaps so you can confirm once you’ve checked it all.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — that’s exactly what I needed. Send it over, and I’ll take a quick look once the details are in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll be near the front entrance, tracking the time and location, and I’m still waiting on Noah’s details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m still waiting on Noah’s repair drive details, too, and I’ll keep an eye out near the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll stay by the front entrance and keep tracking the time and location until Noah sends the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it flexible and start with the bikes and tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll pass that along and keep everyone updated as the repair drive gets moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — I’ll get the bikes and tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word right away and let folks know about the repair drive. It’s great to have everyone pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn—just keep it simple and clear, and send me the route and timing when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and clear, and I’ll send you the route and timing right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 10 works for me too — I’ll confirm it with everyone and send the tool list soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll wait for the confirmed time and tool list before I assign anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll confirm the 10 o’clock time with everyone and send the tool list over soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m checking what repairs the drive is covering and whether they need any specific parts or tools right now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m a bit behind, but I can check what’s still needed and send over the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Noah — please send the repair list when you can, and I’ll keep track of anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries — I’m still waiting on the final timing, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear it. So far, bikes and tools are the main things to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I can help sort and carry bikes and tools once the time’s set. Just let me know when you hear the final timing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ve got the sign-up sheet, and I’ll help keep the repair list and supplies organized. Rosa, let me know what needs fixing first and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send over the updated list with the top priorities and any supplies we still need. The drive’s now on Sunday at the community center, so we can coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for the updated list and help line up the tools and supplies. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive, so just let me know what folks need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’m still piecing together the latest, so if you hear exactly what’s needed, please pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Nell — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know right away if I hear what’s needed.
